ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast dominated by low-intensity (black) pigmentation across approximately 85% of the visible surface, with localized high-intensity (white/grey) pixel clusters comprising approximately 15%.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: A primary high-intensity white mottled region is located in the upper-left quadrant of the left lobe; secondary diffuse high-intensity spotting is present along the distal trailing edge of the right lobe; the central peduncle-to-notch axis is characterized by contiguous low-intensity black pixels.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Defined V-shaped central depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 52 degrees and a depth-to-width ratio of roughly 1:1.5 within its local bounding box.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel-amplitude variations between 5 and 20 pixels; left lobe trailing edge exhibits deeper, more jagged sawtooth peaks compared to the relatively smoother right lobe edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Asymmetrical sweep; left lobe exhibits a more acute, upward-curving convex trajectory on the lateral margin, while the right lobe shows a more elongated, shallower convex curve toward the distal tip.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of high-contrast, roughly circular high-relief pixel groups (calcified organisms) are present along the anterior and lateral margins of both distal fluke tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, unaligned light-grey linear pixel disruptions oriented diagonally across the low-intensity pigmented region of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive peripheral colonization of calcified bio-fouling on both fluke tips; significant irregular tissue loss or jagged serration on the left inner trailing edge compared to the right.
